info.title: WISR API
info.description: API documentation for the WISR application

TimeOfKill.description: Approximate time of day the incident occurred

message.description: Error detail, replaced with a generic string for 5xx

IncidentFilters.description: Available filter values across the incident dataset

Species.description: Wildlife species with display color and species group

LkiDensity.description: Per-segment incident density for the current filters

DensitySegment.description: LKI highway segment with incident density counts

LineGeometry.description: LineString or MultiLineString, discriminated on type

LineString.description: GeoJSON LineString, an ordered array of positions

MultiLineString.description: GeoJSON MultiLineString, an array of LineString coordinate sets

ServiceAreaBoundaries.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of service area boundary polygons

BoundaryFeature.description: GeoJSON Feature for one service area boundary

PolygonGeometry.description: Polygon or MultiPolygon, discriminated on type

Polygon.description: GeoJSON Polygon, outer ring first followed by any holes

MultiPolygon.description: GeoJSON MultiPolygon, an array of Polygon coordinate sets

ServiceAreaLookup.description: Service area matching the given coordinates, or null if outside all boundaries

Route.description: Road route between two points from the BC Route Planner

LkiSyncResult.description: Counts from an LKI segment sync run

HmcrSyncResult.description: Counts from an HMCR sync run

post.summary: Sync LKI highway segments from BC WFS
post.description: Fetches all LKI highway segments from the BC DataCatalogue WFS and upserts them into the local database using chris_lki_segment_id for deduplication. Cluster-internal. Requests carrying x-forwarded-host, which the OpenShift router sets on all public traffic, receive 404.

Fetches all wildlife records from the HMCR API and upserts them into the local database using hmcr_record_id for deduplication. Cluster-internal. Requests carrying x-forwarded-host, which the OpenShift router sets on all public traffic, receive 404.
